objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the command injection weakness of apache httpd 2.4.49 with CGI enabled and read the flag in /tmp/flag.
hints: Find the input the server hands to a system command, and how shell metacharacters are treated.
Find where a request path or parameter is mapped onto the file system.
Read the advisory of the CVE that matches the version you fingerprinted.

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets your input reach a system shell?

steps.title: Fingerprint the version
steps.prompt: Which Apache httpd version serves the site? (x.y.z)

steps.title: Name the CVE
steps.prompt: Which CVE id covers the vulnerable Apache httpd version?

steps.title: Name the second weakness
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets a request escape the intended directory?
